title: apeGmsh: a structural-FEM wrapper around Gmsh with a snapshot FEM broker
description: A structural-FEM wrapper around Gmsh with a composition-based API and a snapshot FEM broker. Loads, masses, and constraints are declared against labels before a mesh exists and resolved once against the generated mesh, yielding a frozen FEMData snapshot that serves as the single contract between Gmsh and any downstream solver. OpenSees is supported as the reference binding, with a typed bridge that emits runnable Tcl or openseespy decks and reads solver output back for interactive and web visualization.
